      noErrors: true

        level: WARN

      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ["nav#TOC a.nav-link.active"]
        - ["nav#TOC [data-toc-expanded]"]

bd-kr6721bn. A value `toc-expand` cannot use warns (Q-13-19) and is
otherwise ignored: no `data-toc-expanded` attribute, so the script opens
the table of contents to its default depth of 1.
